## How to use these resources

These playbooks are built for hiring leaders and founders who are tired of paying 20–30% placement fees for opaque agency work. Each one maps to a concrete decision — modeling recruiting spend, previewing what a real TaaSFlow shortlist looks like, understanding the sourcing and screening workflow, or answering common questions before you start a pilot.

### Who they're for

Founders, heads of talent, and hiring managers running 3–25 open roles who need faster time-to-shortlist without losing pipeline visibility. If you've experienced ghosted retainers, slow shortlists, or per-hire fees you can't justify, start with the ROI calculator, then walk through how a $399 pilot delivers a ranked shortlist for one live role in in days.

### Why the model works

Every candidate you review comes with a fit score, evidence-backed strengths and gaps, and reviewer notes visible in your live client dashboard — not a PDF dropped in your inbox. Subscription pricing replaces placement fees, so hiring five roles costs the same as hiring one, and your team keeps full control of interviews, offers, and onboarding.
